For [finish, redesign], evidence is mixed across 2 tests: one test won with a +5.1% gain after noise correction, while another showed no clear effect (-1.1% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that performed poorly and stopped early ([adoption, redesign], [sign_in, reorder], and [finish, new_screen]).

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Pick Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into an interactive stage layout featuring animated previews and sound feedback when highlighting pets.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and high duration (89s median). Giving dynamic visual previews accelerates adoption confidence.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet to preview their idle animations and sound effects before adopting.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a sound cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Initial Pet Choice
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding to place sign_in after pet selection so users choose their pet companion before creating an account.
candidates.why: Early sign_in drop-off (72.9%) happens before users build an emotional bond with a pet. Moving sign_in right after pick_friend leverages pet selection momentum.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet Companion to the Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet selection and sync progress across devices.

guard.reason: creates urgency to sign in to lock in pet selection

candidates.title: Desktop Display Readiness Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new diagnostic verification screen during the waiting sequence that verifies overlay display permissions and desktop positioning.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to launch. Verifying desktop setup before spawn prevents silent failures.

new_desktop_diagnostic.headline: Desktop Display & Overlay Test
new_desktop_diagnostic.body: Checking system permissions to make sure your pet can roam freely on top of desktop windows.

guard.reason: Inserts a new diagnostic screen within onboarding without removing required steps or violating design rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens adds onboarding friction; past tests with new_screen performed poorly (-6.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control Practice Flow
candidates.change: Transform the home_intro screen into a interactive spotlight flow where users practice summoning, hiding, and dragging their pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to hide or talk to pets, and finish duration is high (395s median).

home_intro.headline: Try Your Pet Controls Now
home_intro.body: Click on your desktop pet to open commands, drag to move, or right-click to hide.

components.text: Right-click your pet anytime to access options or send them to the system tray.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro into an interactive controls spotlight flow while fulfilling its intro function.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off and strong support evidence, but complex practice flows carry implementation cost.

candidates.title: Real-Time Generation Step Breakdown
candidates.change: Display explicit stage milestones with dynamic time estimates while generating the custom pet on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to believe the app stalled during rendering.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Custom Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Building 3D meshes, rendering animations, and optimizing desktop performance.
waiting.hint: This takes around 1-2 minutes. Your pet will spawn automatically when finished.

guard.reason: Adds progress breakdown and dynamic time estimates to the waiting screen for a real generation process.

candidates.score_note: Real-time breakdown mitigates hesitation during the long wait time (2336s mean) without adding new screens.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Banner
candidates.change: Add clear image requirements and contextual lighting hints directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results due to poor input photos.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit frontal photos with a single subject for best AI generation results.

components.text: Tip: Avoid blurry images, group photos, or heavy filters.

candidates.title: Path Selection Duration Clarification
candidates.change: Clarify path titles and time estimates on choose_path so users understand the fast pre-made path versus custom generation.
candidates.why: choose_path drops 23.8% of users and has an 8s median / 514s mean time, indicating hesitation on which path to select.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Adoption Experience
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play pet (1 min setup) or create a custom pet from photos (3 min setup).
choose_path.hint: You can always create additional custom pets later from the main app menu.

guard.reason: Clarifies path durations on choose_path while continuing to offer both adoption and custom pet creation paths.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change targeting initial step drop-off (23.8%) and hesitation.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Benefit Spotlight
candidates.change: Highlight account binding benefits and persistent pet recovery directly above sign-in options.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or account resets after signing back in, showing lack of clarity around account linking.

candidates.change: Enable optional background notifications on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during rendering.
candidates.why: High mean wait time (2336s) causes users to close or abandon the app while waiting for pet asset generation.

waiting.body: We'll notify you desktop-side as soon as your pet is ready to leap onto your screen.

guard.reason: Adds optional background readiness notification to the waiting screen while keeping its core job intact.

candidates.score_note: Background alerts target long rendering wait times to prevent app exit/abandonment.

candidates.change: Switch the pick_friend screen layout from default to a grid layout displaying pet personality tags.

guard.reason: Changes pick_friend layout to a grid view with personality tags while preserving pet choice.
